integrity_statement: The theorem is analytic; numerical examples supplement rather than replace the proof. The 2004 formulation, 2007 automorphism reduction and previously calculated sunlet special case are acknowledged as antecedents. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to connected finite vertex- and edge-transitive simple bases; symmetric nonnegative stochastic chains with uniform stationary measure. No assertion of unrestricted optimizer uniqueness, and finite checks are not an infinite proof. Specialized unindexed coverage remains possible.
title: Universal fastest mixing on one-leaf coronas of transitive graphs
